credentialCards.intro: Create the Apple OAuth client and signed JWT secret outside OM, then obtain an access token with searchadsorg. Access tokens last about one hour; replace them externally. Paste only the access token here. Saving does not verify access or enable the plugin.
usedFor: Read accessible ad accounts and campaigns
